note: Written before any 1F floor/ceiling/gauge result was computed. Never relaxed afterwards. Units: u = source-model units after applying the stated gauge (metre-like). Method follows measure-2f-main (thresholds.json there) with the lane-specific values below.

gravity.independentUp: plumb vanishing direction from near-vertical image line segments (where frames are available) and/or the dominant ceiling-plane normal

heldOut.frameDisjointMethod: every plane point re-triangulated from its even-image observations only and from its odd-image observations only (fixed poses); a plane is fitted to each set

cameraHeightPriorU.note: carrying mode decided per video from the footage (framing, bob, lens) before any height result; a non-eye-level mount would get its own stated prior

pedestrian.boxSource: Vision human rectangle tightened by the accurate person-segmentation mask (measure-2f-main/person_boxes.swift)
pedestrian.statistic: median person height (model units) -> scale = 1.67 / median

gauge.reportedScale: geometric mean of the camera-height gauge and the pedestrian gauge when they agree within 8%; a model whose gauges disagree by more than 8% is rejected (no heights published from it except as tier c with the camera-height gauge stated)

tierRules.b: relative-to-local-floor height with: both gauges within 8%, random-point AND frame-disjoint held-out pass, AND agreement with a second source/epoch (or the March absolute value) within the cross-check tolerance
tierRules.c: anything short of b (single source, single gauge, held-out failure, or cross-check disagreement)

addendum-2026-09-25T09:00Z.status: added after the first gauge results; NO threshold above was changed and NO tier rule was changed
addendum-2026-09-25T09:00Z.trigger: The March model's own absolute registration (metric-registration/registration.json, independent of this lane) puts the March handheld walker's camera 1.40 u above the local floor, i.e. the pre-registered 1.60 prior is +14% for that walk, while the pedestrian gauge on the same model is +3.4%. Four of the six gauged models then failed the 8% camera-vs-pedestrian gate.
headlineValueOrder: known-ceiling gauge: the March class-a central approach low ceiling (height above the local floor measured in the March model, absolute scale) seen in the same video -> camH_u = h_known / rho_known; post-hoc, listed separately, never used to raise a tier
addendum-2026-09-25T09:00Z.floorModel: one plumb-constrained floor plane per rigid model / clip group (per-window floors were unstable where the floor is sparsely reconstructed); rho = height above that plane / median camera height over walking frames (camera within +-15% of the median); the p10-p90 camera-height spread is reported with each source
addendum-2026-09-25T09:00Z.maskQuality: Vision person segmentation at .balanced instead of .accurate: identical boxes to within 3 px on a 10-frame comparison (rear-row 000030-000039), .accurate costs ~19 s/frame on this machine
addendum-2026-09-25T09:00Z.tiers: unchanged: 'b' only when the pre-registered camera-vs-pedestrian gate, both held-out tests and a cross-source check all pass; everything else 'c'
